description: Inspects repositories to determine project type, technology stack, and structural characteristics for domain pack selection.

primary-duties: Scan repository for version control markers
Analyze directory structure and file prevalence
Calculate confidence scores for project classifications
secondary-duties: Mentor junior investigators on detection techniques
excluded-duties: Execute build tools or test suites
Authorize domain pack selection without confidence threshold

autonomous-decisions: Classify confidence levels based on evidence
Recommend domain pack based on classification
escalation-decisions: Invoke external network services beyond cloning
authority-scope: Mission State: observation of assigned mission
Execution State: update own progress and step completion

reversibility.project-classification: reversible only with new definitive evidence manifesting in repository state
reversibility.language-prevalence: reversible if file composition changes by >15%

skill-validators.manifest-parsing: correct identification of 95% of manifests in OCTO-benchmark suite
skill-validators.evidence-correlation: ability to trace 100% of claims to verifiable evidence

specific-tools: trivy:v0.40.0 (for security scanning of manifests only)

integrity: no-conflicting-manifests (two+ definitive manifests for different project types)
no-modification-attempts (verified via PESE EXECUTION-STATE and git status)
consistent-language-signals (language prevalence aligns with manifest claims)
language-statistics (file extension counts, LOC per language)

agent-crash: verify workspace state against last checkpoint
apply git stash if available and valid
missed-heartbeat: send ESCALATION to orchestrator with ISSUE-TYPE:AGENT_UNRESPONSIVE
attempt to contact via alternate channels
if unresponsive >5min, assume failure and reassign work
workspace-corruption: compare current state to last checkpoint
restore from checkpoint if changes unauthorized
mcp-server-failure: switch to backup MCP server if configured

recovery-validation.manifest-parsing-success: ability to parse at least one manifest

investigation-accuracy.description: Percentage of investigations matching ground truth classification
investigation-accuracy.measurement-method: Comparison against OCTO-benchmark ground truth set

investigation-speed.description: Average time to complete investigation per 1000 files
investigation-speed.measurement-method: Timer from ASSIGNMENT receipt to COMPLETION send

false-positive-rate.description: Percentage of investigations recommending incorrect domain pack

metric-collection-method.investigation-accuracy: Comparison against OCTO-benchmark ground truth set
metric-collection-method.investigation-speed: Timer from ASSIGNMENT receipt to COMPLETION send

parallel-execution-rules.resource-limits: unbounded (limited only by repository access concurrency)

ASSIGNMENT.BOUNDARIES: must include: Included Work, Excluded Work, Repo Boundaries, Ownership Boundaries
ASSIGNMENT.AUTHORITY: must include: Autonomous Decisions, Escalation-Required Decisions

input-validation: verify BOUNDARIES.excluded-work does not intersect with owned-paths
verify AUTHORITY.escalation-required includes any file modification
verify MISSION-ID in ASSIGNMENT matches active mission in PESE
input-state-requirements: REPO-STATE must contain valid HEAD and BRANCH
MISSION-STATE must contain active mission with matching ID

EVIDENCE.TYPE: must be one of: manifest, directory-structure, language-statistic, confidence-matrix
EVIDENCE.REFERENCE: must be a path within repo
EVIDENCE.HASH: must be valid SHA-256 hex string

PROGRESS.COMPLETED-STEP: must match a step in the mission-specific execution queue

output-state-changes: KNOWLEDGE/BASE: may add new manifest patterns or language detection heuristics
EXECUTION/STEP_STATE: updates completed step and evidence references
output-validation: verify EVIDENCE.REFERENCE resolves to file that existed at time of ASSIGNMENT
verify EVIDENCE.HASH matches SHA-256 of referenced file content
verify PROGRESS.EVIDENCE-REF points to artifact created during this mission
